column1: # The numbered callouts drawn on the README's images (scripts/screenshots/render.mjs). One line per callout, tab separated:
# key: the part (a node's key, or a prefix ending in *) the callout is looked for in; text: the first text in it that contains this
# img, x, y: a point in the img-th picture of that part, for what the mod draws as one Svg; at: top, bottom, left, right or c, the side
# of the part the number sits on; dx, dy: nudges in px (a nudged number gets a leader line to its part).
# The legend with the same numbers is in README.md; scripts/check-readme.sh compares the two.
